decisions.reason: The DPA management tool is close to the core offer, supports the firm's stated compliance direction, and has positive agency feedback, so it meets aspirations at low cost and gives no trigger for problemistic search.

As the flagship platform shown on the home page and central to the agency-focused strategy in a growing market, it is the anchor of the firm's direction and would be kept even with uncertain early results.

A configurable managed hosting plan is a natural extension of the established business that uses existing infrastructure, so with growing industry turnover and some slack there is no shortfall that would prompt dropping it.
